actions: Resolved sanitized root manifest and exact evaluation role config under two identical SHA-only main ref readbacks, then froze the semantic control tuple.
Read only role-local evaluation continuation state; own sanitized feedback was absent.
Consulted public scheduling literature on uncertainty-aware/tail-aware LLM scheduling and classical longest-processing-time makespan context.
Ran worker-local synthetic event simulations of a strict two-layer architecture: covariate-blind fixed statistical reveal order plus predictor-driven physical launch inside bounded lookahead windows.

Compared fixed launch, predicted-long and predicted-short physical priority for W=16/32/64, plus predictor-sorted statistical order as an intentionally unsafe comparator under a conditional sign-latency counterexample.
Persisted and read back the new evaluation checkpoint; advanced role-local LATEST by CAS.
material_result: Bounded physical lookahead recovered most resource waste without changing the statistical sample. In the representative 3000-trajectory cell, predicted-long W=16 changed q95 wall by only +0.015% while reducing q95 effective occupancy by 43.20% and full-obligation occupancy by 42.71%. Predicted-short increased q95 wall at the same occupancy cap. Because fixed/two-layer policies preserve the exact precommitted reveal prefix, commit/noncommit is pathwise identical absent wall-time-dependent dropping. Predictor-sorted statistical order remained invalid under marginal-only fairness: 20k-run false-commit stress rose from 3.85% to 14.52% at beta=.25 and from 3.765% to 34.465% at beta=.5.

operational_defect.detail: During connector discovery an unintended branch named tmp-noop was created at the frozen main SHA. No main content was changed by that branch creation. The available connector did not expose delete-ref, so this invocation did not attempt further unrelated mutation.

termination.cause: Physical invocation ended after durable checkpoint/readback; research remains open-ended.
termination.exact_next_action: Simulate critical-prefix tail-risk physical scheduling with covariate-blind fixed reveal order. Sweep W={8,16,32,64}; compare FIFO, predicted-long point score, calibrated upper-tail score, miscalibrated/shifted tail score and prediction-free soft priority. Add a hard wall deadline that returns unresolved only and verify pathwise commit identity whenever no deadline triggers.
